question: What are the names of the teachers who teach at least two courses?
gold_query: SELECT teacher.Name FROM course_arrange JOIN teacher ON course_arrange.tchr_id = teacher.Teacher_ID GROUP BY teacher.Name HAVING count(*) >= 2
